decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive strategies through the combination of Gruul-colored cards. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl to ramp up mana quickly, allowing for the casting of powerful spells such as Skred, Mwonvuli Acid-Moss, and Thermokarst to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Arbor Elf and Llanowar Visionary help with mana acceleration and card draw. The deck also includes creatures like Annoyed Altisaur, Avenging Hunter, and Generous Ent to deal significant damage to the opponent and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cheap and efficient burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent while also maintaining a strong board presence with aggressive creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage and aggressive creatures, ultimately ending the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes cards that can generate additional value through sacrificing artifacts and mana acceleration, allowing for explosive plays and quick victories.

The main concept of this deck is to play fast and aggressively, using low-cost creatures like Thraben Inspector and Seeker of the Way to quickly build up a board presence. The deck also includes spells like Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Squadron Hawk and Battle Screech, the deck can generate additional creatures to overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Faithless Looting and Prismatic Strands for card advantage and protection, respectively. Overall, this deck aims to win quickly through efficient creature beats and direct damage spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells and defensive creatures. The Gates serve as both mana fixing and sources of card advantage, allowing the player to consistently hit their land drops and draw into more threats. The deck also features counter spells and protection spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of early game disruption and late game threats, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a win through incremental advantages.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost, efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cheap spells like Mental Note, Preordain, and Thought Scour to quickly fill the graveyard, the deck is able to play powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent for a low cost. Counterspells and bounce effects like Snap provide disruption while maintaining tempo, allowing for aggressive plays. The deck aims to control the battlefield and maintain pressure through efficient use of mana and spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using Golgari Garden and various spell and creature abilities. The deck focuses on generating card advantage and disruption through cards like Raven's Crime, Chainer's Edict, and Crypt Rats. It also utilizes resource management with cards like Llanowar Visionary and Ichor Wellspring. In addition, there are cards that provide removal options, such as Snuff Out and Cast Down. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and eventually gain advantage through cards like Reckoner's Bargain and Avenging Hunter.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing removal spells like Spinning Darkness, Chainer's Edict, and Cast Down while generating value through cards like Ichor Wellspring and Deadly Dispute. It also focuses on ramping up mana with lands like Khalni Garden and Golgari Rot Farm to eventually play powerful threats like Avenging Hunter and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The inclusion of cards like Crypt Rats and Thorn of the Black Rose provides additional ways to control the board and generate card advantage. The deck's strategy revolves around outlasting opponents and overwhelming them with efficient plays.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and utilize cards like Thoughtcast to draw more cards. By combining cheap artifacts with cards like All That Glitters, the deck aims to quickly pump up its creatures and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. Metallic Rebuke provides some control options, while Moon-Circuit Hacker can help push through extra damage. Overall, the goal of this deck is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence while utilizing artifacts synergies to create a powerful and efficient aggro strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, aiming to deal damage quickly and efficiently. It utilizes cheap and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Bushwhacker, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Voldaren Epicure to generate tokens and further pressure the opponent. This deck aims to win as fast as possible by leveraging its aggressive creatures and burn spells.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using aggressive red creatures and burn spells. By playing low-cost creatures such as Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Blast-Runner, along with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to apply pressure early and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Experimental Synthesizer provide additional threats and ways to generate more damage. The key strategy is to unleash a flurry of creatures and burn spells to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with cheap artifact creatures and take advantage of cards that interact with artifacts. By utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite, along with artifact lands like Seat of the Synod and Vault of Whispers, the deck can quickly establish a strong board presence. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Chainer's Edict to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and efficient in its use of artifacts to win the game quickly.

This Aggro-Affinity deck focuses on quickly playing out artifact creatures and using cards like Springleaf Drum and Metallic Rebuke to keep up the pressure on opponents. By utilizing cards like Ornithopter and Frogmite alongside artifacts that boost their power, such as All That Glitters, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed and efficiency. The deck also includes card draw and graveyard hate to maintain card advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. With a mix of low-cost threats and powerful finishers like Myr Enforcer, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

The deck aims to deal damage early and often, finishing off the opponent with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. With a focus on speed and efficiency, this deck is designed to quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on using control elements like counterspells, removal, and protection spells to maintain board control while utilizing gate lands to ramp up mana production. The goal is to control the pace of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy and establishing a strong board presence with creatures like Squadron Hawk and Guardian of the Guildpact. This allows the player to outlast opponents and eventually overwhelm them with powerful creatures and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure to the opponent through efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing card draw and filtering effects, the deck aims to maintain a steady flow of threats and answers. The strategy revolves around tempo plays and controlling the game through counterspells and bounce effects, while also benefiting from the graveyard interaction provided by cards like Thought Scour and Deep Analysis. The deck aims to maintain a proactive game plan while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a powerful creature by attaching multiple low-cost Auras to it. By using cards like Ethereal Armor and All That Glitters, the player can create a large threat that can end the game quickly. The deck also includes protection spells like Mana Tithe and Benevolent Blessing to keep the creature safe from removal. With a mix of efficient creatures and enchantments, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.
